content:
“Become whisper, become shadow.”

**Sneak** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Decreased chance to be detected when sneaking.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | You are 75% harder to detect while sneaking. | 000B9883 | 
| ★★ | 2 | You are 50% harder to detect while sneaking. | 003896FC | 
| ★ | 1 | You are 25% harder to detect while sneaking. | 0004C935 | 

- Sneak stacks with the passive scaling bonus provided by the Agility stat.
- Sneak stacks with the Secret Agent's Legendary mod
- Sneak stacks with Calmex.
- Escape Artist completely eliminates the noise generated by movement, which synergizes with Sneak.
 - The proc ability, which temporarily cloaks the player upon crouching and resets detection to [CAUTION], allows the player to easily evade detection when combined with Sneak.
- Wearing power armor disables the effects of this perk at all ranks.

- Sneak only affects the basic sneaking stat, and has no impact on the other elements of the sneak equation:
 - Sound detection (movement, weapons)
 - Light exposure
- Firing silenced guns caused nearby enemies to instantly detect the player until the *Test Your Metal* update in June 2022, patch 36.

- Improved Sneak Attack Damage
- Noise Reduction
- Light Footed
- Night Eyes
- Secret Agent
